description: This file contains shell script functions and configurations related to Wi-Fi interface setup, including creating and managing hostapd configurations, wpa_supplicant configurations, and handling security/authentication methods for wireless networks. It provides functions to add rates, configure security protocols, manage VLANs, and generate configuration files for wireless interfaces.

methods.name: wpa_supplicant_add_network
methods.description: Adds a new network configuration to wpa_supplicant with specified parameters such as frequency, htmode, and security settings.

methods.name: hostapd_prepare_device_config
methods.description: Generates hostapd configuration for a wireless device with various settings including security, rates, VLANs, and features.

methods.name: hostapd_set_bss_options
methods.description: Sets up BSS (Basic Service Set) specific options for hostapd configuration, including security, rates, and advanced features.

methods.name: hostapd_add_log_config
methods.description: Adds logging options to hostapd configuration based on parameters.

methods.name: hostapd_set_log_options
methods.description: Configures logging levels and modules for hostapd logging configuration.
